item.title: Failure to complete grass cutting, 14th July
item.description:
Junction of Porchester Road & Kingscroft Road. Please fully utilise the staff normally employed cutting verges, that are no longer growing due to the drought, to now go around our streets with strimmers to tidy up all the bits they have missed during routine grass cutting. Other Authorities, eg Bexley in London, also use strimmers when routinely cutting the verges to complete the task & create a much better appearance.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Porchester Road, Gloucester
